column4: $INPUT SKIPPED A JOB BECAUSE OF UK DIFFICULTY.
This message will be given via the typewriter if the UK occurred at the beginning of
the first record of a file. If the UK occurs during the execution phase, a similar
message will be put only on the output tape.
An attempt has been made to assign or unassign the same MCP unit a second time.
The new time constant has already been used to calibrate the time shown. This message
is issued in response to COMD, CLOCK or a valid IPL time and date setting.
